action.action-desc: Mr. Cloud (for himself and Mr. Vicente Gonzalez of Texas) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Armed Services

form.official-title: To modify the report on limitations on performance of depot-level maintenance to include information on each facility.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Depot Data Transparency Act.

section.header: Modification to annual report on depot level maintenance and repair work loads by public and private sectors
section.text: Section 2466(d)(1) of title 10, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking each Defense Agency, the percentage and inserting
in subparagraph (A), as so redesignated, by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:

subparagraph.text: the dollar amount of such expended and projected funds, respectively, disaggregated by covered depot.
